info.title: Lodestore
info.description:
REST API of the Lodestore server. The web UI uses the same API, so everything the UI does can be scripted.

## Authentication

1. `POST /api/v1/auth/login` with `{"username": "...", "password": "..."}`. The response sets the `lodestore_session` cookie.
2. `GET /api/v1/auth/session` returns the user name and a `csrf_token`.
3. Send the cookie with every request. Requests that change data (`POST`, `PUT`, `DELETE`) also need the `X-CSRF-Token` header with that token.

```sh
URL=https://lodestore.example.com
curl -c jar -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"username":"admin","password":"..."}' \
  $URL/api/v1/auth/login
TOKEN=$(curl -s -b jar $URL/api/v1/auth/session \
  | jq -r .csrf_token)
curl -b jar -H "X-CSRF-Token: $TOKEN" \
  -X POST $URL/api/v1/policies/nightly/run
```

A browser request that changes data must also come from the server's own origin (`Origin` header).

## Errors

Errors return a JSON body `{"code": "...", "message": "..."}`. `code` is stable and meant for programs; `message` is meant for people. `401` means there is no valid session, `403` with code `csrf` means the token or origin check failed, `422` means the request was understood but rejected.

post.description: Every other session is signed out; the current one stays. A wrong current password answers 422, not 401, so the interface does not take it for an expired session.

get.summary: Show which agents are outdated and how an update is going
get.description: The signed agent versions on this server, the version, architecture and update state of every host, and the current or just finished rollout with its waves and latest rollbacks.

post.description: Give `hosts` to update those hosts or `outdated: true` to update every outdated host. Only hosts that are behind, not revoked, support self-update and have a signed binary of the target version for their architecture are queued; the rest are counted as skipped. The first hosts form the canary wave, connected hosts first, and the others follow in waves. The token needs the `agents:update` scope; `hosts:write` is not enough.

key.description: The object key the finding is about.

files_per_run.description: `restore` only: a whole number from 1 to 1000. Left out, the saved value stays.

read_per_run.description: `packs` only: a size such as `5GiB`. Left out, the saved value stays.

files_per_run.description: How many files a test restore restores, from 1 to 1000.

read_per_run.description: A size such as `5GiB`: how much of the bucket a pack reading run downloads.

oneOf.description: The newest run that reached a verdict.

findings.description: The first findings; the report lists them all.

ChecksSummary.description: The worst result of the enabled levels, as the repository list shows it.

finished_at.description: When the run that decided `state` finished.

CleanupState.description: Where cleanup of a repository stands, read from the catalog only.

at.description: `waiting`: when deletion may start. `idle`: the next scheduled run.

items.description: Selected paths as base64url bytes without padding.

url.description: Single-use link, valid for 60 seconds; open it as a normal page load.

name_b64.description: Exact name bytes, base64url without padding.

path_b64.description: Exact path bytes, base64url without padding.

path.description: The policy-style path of the field, such as `spec.pause`.

last_ms.description: The newest snapshot of the host that still holds the file.

next_ms.description: The next snapshot of the host, which no longer has it.

oneOf.description: Set when a newer snapshot of the host exists without this file; known once the search is over.

index.description: Position in the order groups were found; it does not change.

last_seen_ms.description: When the server received the newest snapshot holding the file, in milliseconds.

path_b64.description: Exact path bytes, base64url without padding.

revision.description: The revision of the session at the last change of this group.

hosts.description:
Host keys (an agent id or `agentless:{hostname}`) to search, at most 500. Together with
`labels` this is a union; all hosts when both are empty.

labels.description: Also search hosts whose agent carries all of these labels, as `key=value`; at most 20.

pattern.description:
A name fragment (`nginx.conf`), a glob for names (`*.conf`) or a glob for the whole
path (`/etc/nginx/**`); case does not matter; 1 to 255 characters.

since.description: Only snapshots received at or after this time, in milliseconds.

until.description: Only snapshots received at or before this time, in milliseconds.

hosts.description: Hosts with at least one match.

limit.description: The most files (groups) a search keeps.

searched_hosts.description: Hosts whose snapshots the search reads.

time_ms.description: When the server received the snapshot, in milliseconds.

verified_by.description: Who signed the provenance of this snapshot: `server` or `owner`; null when nothing signed it.

content_id.description:
Identifies the content within one repository (16 bytes, hex); empty for an empty file or
a link.

first_ms.description: When the server received the first snapshot holding this version, in milliseconds.

last_ms.description: When the server received the last snapshot holding this version, in milliseconds.

snapshots.description: Snapshots holding this version, signed ones first, then newest first; the first is the one to restore.

verified_by.description: Who signed the provenance of a snapshot holding this version: `server` or `owner`. Null when none is signed; such a version is listed after the signed ones.

recent_runs.description: The last finished backup runs of the host, oldest first, at most 10.

counted.description: Repositories whose size has been counted.

dedup_ratio.description: Logical size divided by the size in the bucket.

after_delete.description:
Deleting had started: some marked packs may be gone already. The
cycle keeps its marker and continues where it stopped, on the next
run or when the server retries it.

postponed.description: Deletion is held back by a running backup or restore.

pause.description: A duration such as `24h` or `2d`, not below the pause floor.

oneOf.description: A dry run in progress, also while a real cycle runs or waits.

The unfinished cycle: the real one when there is one, otherwise a dry
run. `events` belong to it.

The newest cleanup that was not a dry run, when it failed. `None`
once a later one is running or has finished.

pause_effective.description: The pause the next cycle uses: the setting, raised to `pause_floor`.

oneOf.description: Why an outdated host cannot be updated; empty otherwise.

target_version.description: The version this host's update goes to; a rollout keeps it when a newer build appears.

checked_30d_pct.description: Whole percent of packs read in the last 30 days.

Problem.description:
An error with the location of the offending value. `line`/`column` are
1-based and only set for errors that come from the YAML text.

dedup_ratio.description: Logical size divided by the size in the bucket.

checks.description: What the storage checks of the connection found.
The worst result of the integrity checks, from the catalog.

accept_unverified.description: Must be true to restore a snapshot that nothing signed; such a snapshot cannot be restored in place.

destination.description: Absolute path of the folder to restore into; `/` with `in_place`.

items.description: Selected paths as base64url bytes without padding.

restore_owners.description: Restores file owners, setuid/setgid bits and file capabilities. An API token needs the `restore:in-place` scope for it.

allow_in_place.description: Whether the agent allows restores in place; null when unknown.

latest_snapshot_ms.description: Server time of the newest signed snapshot; null when the host has none.

restore_roots.description: Folders the agent restores into, as it reports them; the agent checks them itself.

unverified_count.description: Snapshots of this host that nothing signed; they are never offered as the latest.

other_repository.description: The snapshot is read from a repository other than the one the target host writes to.

source_host_key.description: Agent id of the source host, or `agentless:{hostname}`.

latest_verified_id.description: Id of the newest signed snapshot of the host by server time, whatever the page; null when the host has none.

hash_mismatches.description: Files that did not come back right or could not be restored.

skipped.description: Chosen files that no longer fitted in the size limit.

includeStdin.description: Also applies the rules to stdin snapshots that name this policy; they form the manual pool.

floor.description:
Snapshots no rule keeps that stay only because the two newest complete
snapshots of each host are never forgotten.

pause_reason.description: Why the server paused it, when something other than rollbacks did.

rollback_after_secs.description: How long a switched agent has to come back before it rolls itself back.

skipped.description: Hosts left out: current, revoked, not able to update or already in an update.

truncated.description: More than 500 names match; the rest was not sent.

SearchLine.description: One line of the search stream.

parent_b64.description: Exact bytes of the directory path, base64url without padding.

items.description: Absolute snapshot paths as base64url bytes; a folder brings everything below it.

unverified_reason.description: Why the server marked this snapshot unverified: its data failed the server's check after the backup, or the check could not complete within an hour. Null when the snapshot is not marked.

verified_by.description: Who signed this snapshot's provenance: `server` (the server checked a backup job of the host named by its certificate) or `owner` (a `lode backup` run with the repository password). Null when nothing signed it; such a snapshot is never the latest, is not counted by retention and cannot be restored in place.

outdated.description: Update every outdated host that can be updated.

host.description: `None` when the marker can't be read.

started_at.description: When the bucket stored the marker; `None` when it doesn't say.

bearer.description: API token from Settings → API tokens. Scopes limit what the token can do.

csrf.name: x-csrf-token
csrf.description: Required on every request that changes data. Read the token from `GET /api/v1/auth/session`.
